Everything above about "PREMIER PLAY" comes from the Virginia Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
2414.headline: What's actually left to win

2415.body:
"Double The Money" has gone close to two months without a top prize claim, and tickets kept selling. Only a fixed number of tickets are printed. About half of the tickets are sold, and every remaining $100,000 prize is still unclaimed. That leaves the same top prizes among fewer tickets.

Every line of Double The Money's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
2415.headline: No new top prize claims

2416.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "Loaded with $2,000s", about a third are still unsold. The game is past the halfway point of its run, with 1,193 of 3,372 top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

If you play "Loaded with $2,000s" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2416.headline: Where this game is in its run

2419.body:
"Bronze 7s" can match another game on price and top prize and still pay out very differently. This game is a game that pays many small prizes and few large ones. Of its unclaimed prize money, nearly all is in wins under $70 and the rest is in bigger prizes. Neither kind is better, and each suits different players.

The numbers for "Bronze 7s" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
2419.headline: The prize mix in this game

2420.body:
The most common win left on "Silver 7s" is $5. The second biggest prize left is $7,000, and two of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

The table below shows the full count for "Silver 7s", with every prize level included.

2421.body:

Everything above about "Gold 7s" comes from the Virginia Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
2421.headline: The prize table, line by line

2422.body:
About half of the tickets for "Platinum 7s" are sold. The top prize count has held, with two of three still unclaimed. The number of tickets printed is fixed, so that is a plain good sign.

The table below shows the full count for "Platinum 7s", with every prize level included.
2422.headline: Tickets sell, top prizes remain

2426.body:
About two-thirds of the tickets for "HAUNTED HUNDREDS" have been sold. The game is about halfway through its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, the top prizes and the tickets are going at about the same pace.

The numbers for "HAUNTED HUNDREDS" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
2426.headline: Early stage or late

2427.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "HOLIDAY TRIPLER", most are still unsold. The game is early in its run, with 515 of 602 top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

If "HOLIDAY TRIPLER" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
2427.headline: How much has sold

2428.body:
"PEPPERMINT PAYOUT" has 234,250 prizes of $2 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $500 prize, with 62 left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

Every line of PEPPERMINT PAYOUT's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
2428.headline: What's actually left to win

2429.body:
"MERRY MONEY TREE" is down to three top prizes after a $125,000 winner was claimed yesterday. The game started with four top prizes. Know that before you buy, because a change in top prizes changes the whole game.

Tomorrow's count on "MERRY MONEY TREE" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
2429.headline: Top prize count went down

2430.body:
The top prize count on "WRAPPED IN RICHES" has not moved since we started watching it. The game still has three of three top prizes unclaimed. Smaller prizes keep getting claimed as tickets sell. The same top prizes are now among fewer tickets.

Everything here about "WRAPPED IN RICHES" comes from official Virginia lottery numbers, current through November 16.
